replacements.en: surround the subject with a ring of off-white or white beads to form a complete outline
replacements.zh-CN: 主体外围使用一圈米白色或白色拼豆形成完整描边

replacements.en: surround the subject with a ring of dark charcoal beads to form a complete outline
replacements.zh-CN: 主体外围使用一圈深炭灰色拼豆形成完整描边

replacements.en: add no outline ring, so the subject's own edge beads form its silhouette
replacements.zh-CN: 主体外围不加描边，直接以主体边缘的拼豆形成轮廓

replacements.en: Soft natural light comes from the upper left
replacements.zh-CN: 柔和自然光从左上方照射

replacements.en: Soft natural light comes from the upper right
replacements.zh-CN: 柔和自然光从右上方照射

replacements.en: Soft natural light comes from directly above
replacements.zh-CN: 柔和自然光从正上方照射
